2607.04688.title: URSA: Chemistry-Aware Benchmark for Utilitarian Retrosynthesis Assessment
2607.04688.paper_summary: Synthesis planning aiming to find pathways of reactions for a target molecule is one of the most important and challenging tasks in drug discovery. Recent progress has produced both specialized deep-learning retrosynthesis systems and general-purpose large language models, but objective comparison remains difficult due to the lack of flexible, chemically interpretable benchmarking protocols. In the current study, we are introducing the URSA (Utilitarian RetroSynthesis Assessment) evaluation framework that provides the opportunity to benchmark the synthetic routes not only from a formal perspective, such as convergence to commercially available starting materials, but also from a chemical plausibility perspective, mimicking the way expert chemists evaluate the reactions and routes. The study covers a comprehensive evaluation of both conventional end-to-end retrosynthesis solutions and LLMs for the synthesis planning task on a set of novel, diverse target molecules with undisclosed synthetic routes, which represent realistic tasks in the daily drug design routine. We find that while LLMs can support high-level strategic planning, they currently underperform specialized retrosynthesis models in reliably solving synthesis planning tasks.
2607.04688.paper_summary_zh: 合成規劃旨在為目標分子尋找反應途徑，是藥物發現中最重要且具挑戰性的任務之一。近期的進展產生了專門的深度學習逆合成系統和通用的大型語言模型，但由於缺乏靈活且具化學可解釋性的基準協議，客觀比較仍然困難。在本研究中，我們介紹了URSA（實用逆合成評估）評估框架，該框架提供了從正式角度（例如，收斂到商業可用的起始材料）以及從化學合理性角度來基準合成路徑的機會，模擬專家化學家評估反應和路徑的方式。該研究涵蓋了對傳統端到端逆合成解決方案和大型語言模型在一組新穎、多樣的目標分子（其合成路徑未公開）上的合成規劃任務的全面評估，這些任務代表了日常藥物設計例行工作中的現實任務。我們發現，儘管大型語言模型可以支持高層次的戰略規劃，但它們在可靠解決合成規劃任務方面目前表現不如專門的逆合成模型。
